firstName.intent: Capture the customer's first name for order or service processing
firstName.description: Single name of a person, typically the given name, with exactly one capital letter at the beginning and no special characters or numbers.
firstName.format: Name starting with uppercase letter (e.g. Alice)

lastName.intent: Customer last name field for a customer
lastName.description: Last name of the customer, exactly 5 characters long with no space (e.g. 'Smith')
lastName.format: exactly 5 alphanumeric characters with no spaces

email.description: Email address in the format user@example.com, for example 'alice@example.com'

cardNumber.intent: Enter a valid credit card number
cardNumber.description: A 16-digit numeric value with spaces in the format XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX, representing a payment card
cardNumber.format: 16 digits with spaces (XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX)

expiry.description: Two-digit month and two-digit year in MM/YY format, e.g. 05/23

cvv.intent: Verify Card Verification Value (CVV) for secure payment
cvv.description: A 3-digit number used to confirm card details, following the exact format of '123'

address.intent: To provide the customer's street address, including house number
address.description: Street address format: <house number> <street name>, e.g. '123 Main St'

city.intent: Provide a valid street address including house number
city.description: Street address format: exact city name, e.g. 'San Francisco'

country.intent: Select the country for a customer's shipping address
country.description: Country selection in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code format, chosen from US, DE, GB, FR, AU options

notes.intent: Provide special delivery instructions for the customer.
notes.description: Leave specific delivery instructions at door, e.g. ring bell, leave in mailbox, etc.
notes.format: phrases such as 'ring bell', 'leave on porch', 'sign for package'
exampleValues: Ring the doorbell and leave the package on the front porch.
Leave the package with a neighbor at 123 Main St.
Place the package in the secure locker on the left side of the building.
Call me at 555-1234 to arrange for delivery.
Leave the package in the mailbox, but only if it fits.
Ring the bell and then leave the package inside the house.
If no one is home, leave the package with the mailman.
Put the package on the top step of the porch.
Leave a note with the package saying 'Happy Birthday'!
Bring the package up to the third floor apartment 3B.

newsletter.description: Checkbox. Use "on" to check, "" to uncheck.

terms.description: Checkbox. Use "on" to check, "" to uncheck.

deliverySpeed.intent: Select the desired delivery speed option
deliverySpeed.description: Specify how quickly an order should be delivered, including options such as Standard, Expedited, and Express.

promoCode.intent: To enter a promo code for overnight delivery
promoCode.description: A promo code in the format 'Promo code (if any)' with empty string as no code is provided, or a short alphanumeric sequence
promoCode.format: Alphanumeric characters followed by optional space and 'Promo code (if any)' enclosed in single quotes

quantity.intent: To specify the quantity of items purchased
quantity.description: An integer value representing the number of items, expected format is a single digit or multiple digits with no leading zeros (e.g. '1', '12')
quantity.format: Single or multiple digits with no leading zeros

deliveryDate.intent: Date of delivery for an order
deliveryDate.description: Date in the future that indicates when a customer would like to receive their order. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

phone.intent: Customer phone number for delivery or support
phone.description: A phone number in the format '123-456-7890' with a US area code, exactly 10 digits including spaces, used to contact customers
